lines.text: You read every page. All fourteen of them. But did you understand it?
Rental agreements. NDAs. Loan terms. And hidden inside: unlimited liability, auto-renewal traps, penalties you never saw coming.
LegiSense reads the fine print for you, before you sign it.
Upload any document. PDF, scan, paste, or link. It classifies, extracts, and reads every clause in seconds.
Every clause gets a risk score. Every sentence becomes plain English. And missing protections get flagged, before they cost you.
Have a question? Just ask. You get cited answers, straight from your own document.
Deadlines tracked. Fairer counter-clauses drafted. Full reports, ready to share.
